courses.title: Earth System Evolution
courses.description: Course introducing the exploration of how the Earth system has evolved over time as an integrated system in the broader context of planetary habitability.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Atmospheric Dyanmics II
courses.description: This course emphasizes physical concepts and analytic techniques for solving problems in atmospheric instabilities and wave dynamics at various temporal and spatial scales.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Ocean Dynamics
courses.description: An advanced class on the ocean circulation as a dynamical system to understand the basic equations governing it, together with its variability.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Glacier Dynamics
courses.description: This course covers the fundamentals of glacier and ice-sheet dynamics and their application to problems in sea level, paleoclimate, and planetary science.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Physical Properties and Rheology of Rocks
courses.description: Structure, physical properties, and rheology of minerals and rocks with applications to engineering structures and natural phenomena in the Earth. Fundamentals of rock mechanics and crack propagation. Crosslisted with CEE 6751.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Sea Level Rise and Coastal Geotechnics
courses.description: This course covers the fundamentals of modern sea level science, and the related engineering design challenges of coastal infrastructure.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Geomicrobiology
courses.description: Interactions between microorganisms and the geosphere; microbial energetics and genetics; geochemical controls on microbial diversity and activity; redox and acid-base balances; biogeochemical cycles; evolution. Crosslisted with BIOL 6765.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Air Pollution Physics and Chemistry
courses.description: Interaction to the physical and chemical processes affecting the dynamics and fate of air pollutants at the local, regional, and global scales. Particular emphasis is on tropospheric pollutant chemistry and transport. Crosslisted with CEE 6790.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Air Pollution Meteorology and Chemistry
courses.description: Air pollution history, atmospheric stability and boundary layer dynamics, atmospheric dispersion, atmospheric transport, air pollution modeling. Crosslisted with CEE 6792.

courses.subject: EAS
courses.title: Atmospheric Aerosols
courses.description: Chemical and physical properties of natural and anthropogenic aerosols. Sources, transport, transformation, and fate of primary/secondary, organic/inorganic, atmospheric semi-volatiles and aerosols. Crosslisted with CEE 6795.
